Scott Melker outlines what crypto investors need to know about Coinbase's (COIN) spot margin launch.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Why Tristan Thompson backed Anthropic early and is still bullish
items.summary: Former NBA player and early Anthropic investor Tristan Thompson sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to explain why he compares backing Anthropic to buying Google in the dot-com era. He also breaks down the secret behind his famous family's brand empire and why LeBron James will almost certainly own an NBA team.

items.title: Brian Armstrong on bitcoin’s bottom, AI trading agents and Coinbase’s next act
items.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong joins Aoyon Ashraf from TomorrowX Summit where he breaks down why Coinbase is building financial accounts and payment rails for AI agents, why he believes 99.9% of all transactions will eventually be made by agents rather than humans, and why open weight models collaborating in teams are the antidote to a future dominated by a handful of all-powerful frontier labs.

items.title: Coinbase Reportedly Plans To Launch In-House Prediction Markets In Early 2027
items.summary: Coinbase plans to bypass third-party partners like Kalshi and debut its own proprietary event contracts for American investors in early 2027.
